setup.title: Tell us who you are, without telling anyone
setup.body: Others only see your age band and gender.

form.underage: RightPlace is for adults only. You can join when you turn 18.

location.title: Location
location.body: Shows you on the map based on where you are
location.denied: Permission denied: location stays off. You can turn it on in your phone settings.

form.creator: I'm a creator: I organise nights

mapView.hint: Which map you see when you open the app. The switch on the map only changes the current session.

city.title: Map city
city.autoOff: Turn on location to pick the city automatically; otherwise we use {{city}}.

handle.title: Choose your @tag
handle.body: Others will only see this, your age range and gender. We drew one for you: keep it or pick another.
handle.freeUntilContinue: Until you tap Continue you can change your @tag as often as you like. After that, you can change it once every 30 days.

delete.explainBody: We immediately erase your profile, declarations, photos, messages and follows. This cannot be undone.
delete.confirmBody: Last step: your account will be permanently deleted within 24 hours.

followers.title: Your followers
followers.empty: Nobody follows you yet. Share your @tag with friends.

findMe.title: Be found
findMe.body: Your number stays on your phone: we only send an encrypted code, so friends who have you in their address book can find you.
findMe.label: Your number
findMe.saved: Done: friends with your number in their address book can now find you.
findMe.cleared: People can no longer find you by number.

handleEditor.label: Your @tag
handleEditor.warning: Don't use your first and last name: your @tag is visible to everyone.
handleEditor.rules: 3 to 20 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, dot and underscore.
handleEditor.limit: You can change it once every 30 days.
handleEditor.freeChange: You can change it right now, once; after that, once every 30 days.
handleEditor.nextChange: You will be able to change it again on {{date}}.

status.error: I can't check right now: you can still try to save.

format.badChars: Lowercase letters, numbers, dot and underscore only.
format.badStart: It must start with a letter.
format.badEnd: It must end with a letter or a number.
format.doubleDot: No two dots in a row.

avatar.title: Profile photo
avatar.hint: Only you and people you have an accepted follow with (who follow you and whom you follow) can see it. Everyone else sees your initial.

posts.emptyMine: Your day-after posts show up here for 7 days.
posts.loadError: We can't load the posts. Pull down to try again.
